summary:
Pope Leo XIV had surgery on Tuesday to remove a cancerous growth from his lung, the Vatican announced. Surgeons removed a lower lobe of his right lung, and the Vatican said the pope had a 'peaceful night' in hospital. He was due to begin recovery on Wednesday while awaiting the results.

Russian strikes overnight left 600,000 people in Ukraine without power, President Volodymyr Zelensky said, after hitting what he called critical infrastructure. Emergency services said at least three people were killed, while other reports put the toll at six. Zelensky said Ukraine had received no warning from Western allies before a Russian ballistic missile attack on a Kyiv power plant.

Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia intensified, with a strike on Riyadh's international airport described as the group's deadliest against the kingdom. Saudi authorities said they intercepted drone and missile attacks, and the Energy Ministry said an administrative building of Saudi Aramco in Dhahran was hit, causing a limited fire. Debris from intercepted missiles injured four people in Riyadh.

headlines.title: Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer surgery, Vatican says
headlines.summary: Pope Leo XIV had surgery on Tuesday to remove a cancerous growth from his lung, the Vatican announced. A lower lobe of his right lung was removed, and the Vatican said he had a 'peaceful night' in hospital, with results awaited.

headlines.title: Russian strikes leave 600,000 without power in Ukraine
headlines.summary: Overnight Russian strikes left 600,000 people without power, Zelensky said, after hitting what he called critical infrastructure. Emergency services said at least three people were killed, while other reports put the toll at six.

headlines.title: Houthi strikes hit Riyadh airport and a Saudi Aramco building
headlines.summary: The Houthis struck Riyadh's international airport, and Saudi Arabia said it intercepted missiles targeting Riyadh and Dhahran. An administrative building of Saudi Aramco in Dhahran was hit, causing a limited fire, the Energy Ministry said.

headlines.title: Starlink speed limits disrupt Ukrainian military drone missions
headlines.summary: Starlink restricted the operation of internet terminals in Ukraine overnight, disrupting military missions, an adviser to President Zelensky said. Ukraine received no prior warning about the restrictions.

headlines.title: Former Congolese president Kabila joins M23 rebels in new alliance
headlines.summary: Former DR Congo president Joseph Kabila has joined the Rwanda-backed M23 group to lead a new political and military alliance. The coalition, the Front pour la refondation de la nation, is vowing to topple the Congolese government.

headlines.title: White House asks Greece ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign
headlines.summary: The White House said on Tuesday it had asked Ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign amid allegations of improper conduct. Reports alleged she sought $100,000 from a Trump supporter to pay personal credit card debt.

headlines.title: Ukrainian soldier goes on trial over Nord Stream pipeline sabotage
headlines.summary: Serhii Kuznetsov, a Ukrainian special forces officer, is on trial in Hamburg over the 2022 attack on the Nord Stream gas pipelines. He denies involvement in the blasts that badly damaged the pipelines.

headlines.title: Judge keeps White House access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
headlines.summary: US District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that the Trump administration must keep granting the three outlets access to the White House while their lawsuit proceeds. The administration had blocked their access in September.
